newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA - UNIBANKA PLANS EUROBOND ISSUE BY MID-YEAR.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA - UNIBANKA PLANS EUROBOND ISSUE BY MID-YEAR.

text.p: One of Latvia's leading banks, Unibanka is hoping to do a small eurobond issue in the middle of 1997, the bank's president said on Monday.
"I hope to see it in the middle of the year", Unibanka president Andris Berzinsh told Reuters in an interview.
The bank has already been approached by international investment banks interested in managing the offer.
"We have had proposals from some big names who wants to assist in this process", Berzins said.
He said the issue would be small by the eurobond market standards, where issues normally start from 50 million dollars.
Berzinsh earlier said that the bank was also planning to issue GDRs worth $10 million.
